status: predeclared acceptance procedure; no gameplay or performance result

isolation.process_guard: full executable plus process start time
isolation.screenshots: start, milestones, failure before recovery, end; unique tick/UTC/event names

fixture.creation: new vanilla colony with installed DLC and the isolated development bridge; recorder absent
fixture.world_pawns: retain and census the generated world population
fixture.source_of_truth: immutable serialized baseline save hash, game build, active-mod hashes and complete pawn census recorded before timing
fixture.parameter_changes: new named attempt and new baseline; never inherit old measurements

functional.before_after_oracles: independent native state and saved XML; event IDs, subjects, payload, clocks and durable journal must reconcile
functional.scope_semantics: observed holder changes retain observation intervals; snapshots alone do not become exact movement events

performance.fixed_speed: pin observed native speed in the baseline receipt before timing
performance.logger_off: recorder package absent; bridge and DLC unchanged

ordinary_hook_measurement.scope: sum of recorder-owned prefix and postfix capture, comparison and enqueue time for one native invocation; exclude original game method execution
ordinary_hook_measurement.acceptance_grouping: each ordinary collector family separately; also report pooled results
ordinary_hook_measurement.baseline_and_checkpoint_flush: measure separately; do not hide them in ordinary hook results
ordinary_hook_measurement.percentile: nearest rank, ceil(0.95*n), sorted elapsed samples

performance.unstable_runs: retain as failed or uncertain and rerun the affected pair; never revise thresholds after seeing a failure

final_acceptance: fresh reviewer reproduces consequential packaged, native, chronology, branch, fault, preservation and performance evidence against exact final artifacts
